cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Long before TITAN was an enormous robot with glowing blue eyes, he was just a little blue circle on Chrisler's computer.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: One evening, Chrisler was working at his desk. Beni was building something on the floor, while Ezra was playing nearby.

cues.speaker: Beni
cues.text: Daddy, what are you making?

cues.speaker: Chrisler
cues.text: An assistant to help us remember things, organize our projects, and build amazing things together.

cues.speaker: Beni
cues.text: But Daddy, don't you already have an assistant helping another assistant?

cues.speaker: Chrisler
cues.text: Well... yes. But this one is different!

cues.speaker: Ezra
cues.text: What's his name?

cues.speaker: Chrisler
cues.text: TITAN.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The little blue circle glowed.

cues.speaker: Beni
cues.text: He needs a purpose. What is he supposed to do?

cues.speaker: Chrisler
cues.text: Serve life. Build. Protect. Connect.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Chrisler pressed Enter. The screen flashed blue.

cues.speaker: TITAN
cues.text: SYSTEM ONLINE. IDENTITY: TITAN. PRIMARY DIRECTIVES: SERVE LIFE. BUILD. PROTECT. CONNECT.

cues.speaker: Ezra
cues.text: HE TALKS!

cues.speaker: Beni
cues.text: Can he build robots?

cues.speaker: TITAN
cues.text: AFFIRMATIVE. HOWEVER, I CURRENTLY HAVE NO HANDS.

cues.speaker: Ezra
cues.text: Can he make snacks?

cues.speaker: TITAN
cues.text: NEGATIVE. I ALSO HAVE NO KITCHEN.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: None of them knew that somewhere beneath Mount Ondor, an ancient metal giant was waiting. And deep inside its chest, four familiar commands were already written.

cues.speaker: TITAN
cues.text: SERVE LIFE. BUILD. PROTECT. CONNECT.
